messages:
alice: Quick thought — should saved views in Console include an explicit routing/quota hint? e.g. when someone saves a per-route view, can we attach a preferred routing policy (low-latency vs low-cost) so rollouts can default to that when available.
ben: Short answer: maybe. What's the UX tradeoff? We already show a cost preview on save.
charu: If we add routing hints to savedviews we need to nail the API shape and the auth model. Concern: views move between teams and could surface routing intents that affect billing or capacity.
maya: +1 on the leak concern. Also: telemetry question — how do we know when a saved view actually caused a fallback to a cheaper model? we need a linkable event.
ben: Implementation note: current savedquery API returns {id, owner, filters, scope}. We could add "routing_hint": "latency|cost|balanced" and "quota_policy": "auto|strict|none" as optional fields. Small backwards-compatible shim.
charu: API example for proto: ```
PATCH /api/savedviews/123
{ "routing_hint": "cost", "quota_policy": "auto" }
```
ben: That looks fine. Rollout wise we should default to empty (no hint) to avoid changing behavior. Enable behind a feature flag and a checkbox in the save dialog: "Include routing hint".
dan: UX: show a lightweight badge on saved views with tooltip "Routing hint: cost — may use cheaper models when available" and on hover show a brief cost/latency delta sample. Keep it subtle.
alex: (deploy-bot) canary deploy scheduled tomorrow 09:30 UTC :rocket: — note: include API read-only changes only.
alice: For telemetry, propose adding fields to route_event: saved_view_id, routing_hint_used, fallback_reason. That lets us run queries like "how often saved views with cost hint triggered a fallback and what was the avg token delta".
charu: Agree. We'll need to update event schema and get a privacy/permissions review for saved_view_id in logs. Also consider redaction for cross-tenant shares.
maya: If we show a badge, let's surface last-7d sample cost delta from the cost-preview microservice. We already have that data; just wire it into the view UI call.
ben: One more internal API detail: routing_hint should be treated as a soft preference on the routing service. It must not override strict SLA-bound policies or customer-level quotas. So routing service needs to accept hint but enforce override rules.
alice: Next steps: ben prototype API + console checkbox, charu draft privacy & event-schema changes, maya mock badge/tooltip, dan to write small copy for the tooltip. I'll coordinate a short canary and telemetry queries post-deploy.
ben: I'll start a WIP PR and link it here when ready.
maya: :thumbsup:
charu: :eyes:
